description: Defines classes and structures for handling and logging O-RU metrics, including JSON, log, and STDOUT consumers, with references to external metrics and PCI data.

classes.name: ru_metrics_consumer_json
classes.description: Handles O-RU metrics and processes them into JSON format.

classes.name: ru_metrics_consumer_log
classes.description: Logs O-RU metrics to a specified log channel.

classes.name: ru_metrics_handler_stdout
classes.description: Outputs O-RU metrics to STDOUT, with header printing control.

methods.name: print_header
methods.description: Prints header for STDOUT metrics output.

methods.name: log_ru_sdr_metrics_in_stdout
methods.description: Logs SDR RU metrics to STDOUT.

methods.name: log_ru_dummy_metrics_in_stdout
methods.description: Logs dummy RU metrics to STDOUT.

methods.name: log_ru_ofh_metrics_in_stdout
methods.description: Logs OFH RU metrics to STDOUT.
